title: Private Space Needle & Seattle Cultural District Tour
includes: Access to the Space Needle observation deck
Views of Seattle, Puget Sound, and Mount Rainier
Timed entry ticket to the Space Needle
Private walking tour of Seattle Center and Uptown
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels

This 2-hour experience is a walking tour and includes approximately one hour of guided walking around Seattle Center, the area surrounding the Space Needle, before entering the attraction. Guests should expect to walk approximately 1 mile (1.6 km) during the tour. While the pace is relaxed, it may be challenging for those not accustomed to longer distances. We recommend wearing comfortable footwear and being prepared for uneven streets.

We’re happy to offer wheelchair-accessible tours with advance notice. Some elements of our standard routes may not be fully accessible, but with early communication, we can easily adjust the itinerary to ensure a smooth and enjoyable experience for all guests. If you or someone in your group has mobility needs, please let us know when booking so we can make the necessary arrangements.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover Seattle's vibrant cultural district on a private walking tour with a local guide. Explore the area surrounding the iconic Space Needle as you uncover city's history, architecture, art, and music. See landmarks including the Museum of Pop Culture (MoPOP), Chihuly Garden and Glass, and the International Fountain while learning the stories that shaped the city. Then ascend 520 feet to the top of the Space Needle with included admission and enjoy spectacular 360-degree views of Seattle, Puget Sound, and Mount Rainier. With a private guide and personalized experience, this tour is the perfect introduction to one of Seattle's most iconic neighborhoods.

Highlights
- Private walking tour of Seattle Center and Uptown
- Enjoy 360-degree views of Seattle and Puget Sound
- See MoPOP, Chihuly Garden and Glass, and the International Fountain
- Learn about Seattle's history, culture, and music scene
- Personalized experience with a local guide
